text: If you're hoping for a dry, lazy Sunday on the water, get out early, because the sky's got other plans this afternoon. Highs climb near 83 with a south wind gusting to 25, and while NWS keeps today's rain chance modest at 30%, the models are split hard, the American keeps it dry-ish but the European is much wetter, and given the flash flood watch the forecasters are flagging, I'd bet on the wetter read. Showers and thunderstorms build through the afternoon and really take over tonight, with a soaking 90% chance and up to half an inch of rain likely. That system sticks around into Monday too, with more showers and storms and a similar flash flood risk, before things quiet down Tuesday. The lake's got a wind advisory today, waves 2 to 3 feet, so small craft should stay in. Air quality's good, no smoke worries. Get your outdoor plans done by early-to-mid afternoon, I wouldn't be on the broad lake or starting anything long outside past 2 or 3 today.
